subject: *: update tipb to support columnar index (#60207)
summary: Reviewed `pkg/planner/core/plan_to_pb.go` delta vs parent: `PhysicalTableScan.ToPB` and `partitionTableScanToPBForFlash` now serialize ANN/vector-index pushdown via `TableScan.UsedColumnarIndexes` / `PartitionTableScan.UsedColumnarIndexes` using `tipb.ColumnarIndexInfo{IndexType: TypeVector, Index: AnnQueryInfo}`, replacing the previous direct `AnnQuery` field (now `DeprecatedAnnQuery` in tipb). No Blocker/High issues found in planner correctness/semantics/protocol handling for this change.
